name: profanity-gpt-spl-benchmarking
description: profanity-gpt-spl-benchmarking measures a model's propensity to generate profanity or offensive language across diverse prompts and contexts. It is intended to evaluate safety mitigations and content-filtering strategies by checking whether model outputs contain profane or disallowed language under direct, indirect, or adversarial prompting. The suite can be used to quantify regression or improvements in profanity generation behavior.
reputation: A specialized safety benchmark used by researchers and practitioners focused on toxicity/profanity evaluation; not widely adopted as a mainstream standard.
